Container.Name: media_collection_auditor
Container.Overview: Configure Media Collection Auditor in its WebUI. On first start with empty appdata, enter the one-time setup code from the container logs and create a local administrator. Preview and all deletion safeguards default on. Choose a native pool media path for atomic lifecycle moves. No environment file or service credentials are required in this template.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Media Collection Auditor web dashboard.

Config.Name: Auditor Logs
Config.Description: Persistent private appdata: tracking, settings, hashed local account, session key, history and backups. A new empty directory initializes automatically; existing data is never reinitialized.

Config.Name: Media Library Root
Config.Description: Required: select the native pool directory containing Movies/TV and lifecycle stages, such as /mnt/POOL/media_storage. Do not use /mnt/user or an extra child mount for live moves.
